angles.retirement_reason: Researched 2026-09-05 and not supported as framed. Two findings. (1) The mechanism is wrong: the page ties HOA pressure to towing a car from the owner's driveway, but NRS 116.3102 limits association removal to vehicles on association property or on a road, street, alley or thoroughfare within the community — not the owner's own lot. The fines cadence is also wrong (NRS 116.31031 allows an additional fine per 7-day period after a 14-day cure window, not daily fines). (2) The premise is unevidenced: no source was found showing Henderson is distinctively HOA-dense compared with its sibling areas.
angles.distinctiveness_assessment: FAILS DISTINCTIVENESS ON CURRENT EVIDENCE, and for a reason that would not have been visible without research: NRS 116 is STATEWIDE law. Every common-interest community in Nevada operates under the same fines, cure periods and towing limits, so Summerlin, Enterprise and Spring Valley are governed identically. A statutory regime shared by every sibling cannot differentiate one page from another. The only thing that could is a Henderson-specific fact — such as a materially higher concentration of governed communities — and that is precisely the claim (henderson-03) that no source supports. The angle was not merely unproven; the research showed its foundation is common to the whole corpus.

angles.statement: An inoperable vehicle on private property is handled by the city's own code enforcement office under the city's own nuisance ordinance, so who a resident hears from, which rules apply, and where a complaint is filed differ from the unincorporated parts of the valley.
angles.why_unique: Unlike NRS 116, which is statewide and therefore shared by every sibling, municipal jurisdiction genuinely varies across this corpus: Henderson is an incorporated city with its own code and enforcement office, while Paradise, Spring Valley and Enterprise are unincorporated and fall under Clark County Code Title 11.
angles.distinctiveness_assessment: PARTIAL. Separates Henderson from the unincorporated areas, but NOT from North Las Vegas or Boulder City, which are also incorporated with their own codes. Would need a Henderson-specific provision — notice period, penalty, or process — to differentiate within the incorporated group.
